entries.title: Monetary Policy Statement for October 2026
entries.note: Read from the PDF on 2026-10-31: at a special meeting on 14 October 2026 the Monetary Policy Committee raised the Central Bank Rate by 225 basis points from 9.75 percent to 12.0 percent; headline inflation was 4.6 percent in September 2026 (4.1 percent in August) and core inflation 3.7 percent; the committee projects headline inflation of 7.0-7.5 percent over the next 12 months and cites exchange-rate depreciation pressure. The statement gives no exchange-rate level on the pages read. Time-sensitive: a later Monetary Policy Committee decision supersedes it, so recheck before any release. Claim-level review 2026-10-31 (kaizen pass 2, run for Peter Bamuhigire; no human reviewer).
